role: On-device Apple Intelligence provider (Foundation Models, iOS 26+): availability check, prewarm, a process-wide LanguageModelSession cache with a token ledger used by chat turns only (side sends run on one-off sessions), per-turn planning (Apple-specific instructions, relevance-ranked tools that fit the 4K window, compacted transcript, tool-output allowance), streaming through ProviderStream with one trimmed retry on context overflow, error translation, plus AppleReplyTrimmer/AppleReplyRelay that end capped replies at a complete sentence.
types: SessionRequest: struct (private) — what a send asks of the cache
SessionLease: struct (private) — leased session + fresh flag + follow-up tool budget
SessionCache: actor (private) — single cached LanguageModelSession with signature/ledger
TurnPlan: struct (private) — instructions/tools/transcript/allowance for one attempt + isChatTurn
FailedAfterOutput: struct Error (private) — stream failure after text was shown
UnreadableSnapshot: struct Error (private) — a stream snapshot with no readable text
AppleReplyTrimmer: enum — 150-word length rule and sentence-boundary trimming
AppleReplyRelay: struct — converts cumulative snapshots into sentence-at-a-time deltas

toplevel: All Foundation Models code is under #if canImport(FoundationModels) and @available(iOS 26, *); without it send() fails with unsupportedOS and isAvailable is false. id is a stored let .apple. Only chat turns (a prompt composed by AssistantSystemPrompt, recognised by its cache marker) lease the shared SessionCache and touch the AppleToolDispatcher; the summarizer, fact extraction and voice interjections run on a one-off session with no tools.

units.does: The session for a plan: for a chat turn the shared SessionCache lease (reused or adopted); for any other send a one-off LanguageModelSession with the plan's instructions, marked fresh, which the cache never sees — so a side send cannot replace the chat's cached session.

For a chat turn: fetches the AppleToolDispatcher on MainActor, installs this attempt's tool-output allowance (resetting its call count) and returns it; nil for any other send, which has no tools and must not reset a chat turn's count or allowance mid-generation.

Yields what the text adds past the length already shown and appends it to shown. Snapshots normally extend the shown text, so that is exactly the new part; a snapshot that rewrote shown text (the chat appends deltas and cannot retract one) adds only what lies past the shown length, so nothing is repeated; a shorter or equal snapshot yields nothing.

branches.cond: text not longer than what was shown
